contract.task_clause:
Why are there no impact craters on the surface of Io?
Option A: Io did have impact craters but they have all been buried in lava flows.
Option B: It is too small to have been hit during the Late Heavy Bombardment
Option C: Jupiter's strong gravity attracted the planetesimals more strongly than Io and thus none landed on its surface.
Option D: Any craters that existed have been eroded through the strong winds on Io's surface.
